title: JSON API: tags, locations, invoices, attachments, dashboard
interface: Blueprint `bp` (name 'api_taxonomy', no url_prefix; mounted at /api/v1). All routes api_auth_required. Tags: GET /tags -> list; POST /tags {name, color?} -> 201 | 400 (bad color via ValueError) | 409 (IntegrityError); PATCH /tags/<int:id> -> 200 | 404; DELETE /tags/<int:id> -> 204 | 404. Locations: GET /locations; POST /locations {name, address?, notes?} -> 201 | 409; PATCH /locations/<int:id>; DELETE /locations/<int:id> -> 204 | 404 | 409 (IntegrityError: referenced). Invoices: GET /invoices?q= -> list (search when q else list_all); POST /invoices {number, supplier?, issued_at?, total?, currency?, notes?} -> 201 | 400 (missing number) | 409; GET /invoices/<int:id> -> invoice dict + 'assets' (AssetService.assets.search_assets(invoice_id=id)) + 'attachments' (AttachmentRepository.list_for('invoice', id)) | 404; PATCH /invoices/<int:id>; DELETE /invoices/<int:id> -> 204 | 409; POST /invoices/<int:id>/assets {asset_ids: [...]} -> 200 {'attached': n} via AssetService.attach_invoice. Attachments: GET /assets/<int:id>/attachments -> list; POST /assets/<int:id>/attachments multipart (fields kind, file) -> 201 attachment dict | 400 (AttachmentError) | 404; POST /invoices/<int:id>/attachments likewise (owner_type 'invoice'); GET /attachments/<int:id> -> the file via send_file(path_for(id), as_attachment=True, download_name=filename, mimetype=mime_type) | 404; DELETE /attachments/<int:id> -> 204 | 404. GET /dashboard -> DashboardService stats(today=date.today().isoformat()). Services from src/services/factory.py (build_asset_service, build_attachment_service, build_dashboard_service) and repositories on get_db(). Actor via guards.actor().

uses.config constants: src/config.py: ASSET_TYPES, ASSET_STATUSES, ASSET_CONDITIONS, TAG_COLORS, ATTACHMENT_KINDS, ATTACHMENT_OWNERS, ATTACHMENT_ALLOWED_TYPES, HANDOVER_KINDS, HANDOVER_STATUSES

database: services from src/services/factory.py on get_db() per request
